course.title: C Programming
course.tagline: Zero se advanced C — pointers, memory aur real compiler ke saath
course.description: BroCode ka complete C Programming course: 20 modules, ISO C17, Hinglish explanations, real compiler notebook, 40 labs, 15 projects, 180+ interview questions aur module-wise assessments. Har module 22-block learning template follow karta hai — definition se checkpoint tak.
outcomes: C program likhna, compile karna aur debug karna
Pointers, arrays, strings aur memory ko visually samajhna
Structures, dynamic memory aur file handling me confidence
Algorithms aur data structures ko C me implement karna
Interview aur viva ke C questions ka structured answer dena

modules.title: Introduction to C Programming
modules.goal: Program ka idea, C ka itihaas aur pehla C program compile karke chalana.
modules.brief: Program instructions ki list hai: input lo, memory me rakho, calculate karo, output do. C me ye instructions .c text file me likhi jaati hain.

modules.title: C Development Environment
modules.goal: GCC toolchain chalana, compile flags samajhna, compile aur linker errors padh kar fix karna.
modules.brief: C khud kuch nahi chalata — compiler chahiye. Linux/macOS par GCC/Clang; Windows par MSYS2/MinGW-w64 ya WSL sabse aasan rasta hai.

modules.title: Variables and Data Types
modules.goal: Har C data type, sizeof, scope/lifetime, storage classes, conversion aur overflow ko practically samajhna.
modules.brief: C statically typed hai: type compile time par fix hota hai aur variable ka size bhi. int typically 4 bytes, char 1 byte, double 8 bytes — exact size platform par depend karta hai, isliye sizeof use karo.

modules.title: Input and Output
modules.goal: printf/scanf family, format specifiers, string input aur input validation ko safely use karna.
modules.brief: printf format string + arguments leta hai. Har % specifier batata hai value kaise print karni hai: %d int, %f double, %c char, %s string, %p pointer, %zu size_t.

modules.title: Operators and Expressions
modules.goal: Arithmetic se bitwise tak har operator, precedence/associativity aur short-circuit evaluation ko samajhna.
modules.brief: Arithmetic (+ - * / %) integer operands par integer division karta hai: 7/2 = 3. % sirf integers par chalta hai aur negative numbers par sign dividend ka hota hai (-7 % 3 = -1).

modules.title: Conditional Statements
modules.goal: if/else, else-if ladder, switch aur validation logic se real decisions lena.
modules.brief: if ke brackets me expression hota hai; 0 false hai, baaki sab true. Block me ek se zyada statements ho to braces zaroori hain.

modules.title: Loops
modules.goal: for, while, do-while, nested loops, break/continue aur dry run se iteration master karna.
modules.brief: for (init; condition; update) tab best hai jab iterations ki count pata ho. while tab jab condition pehle se pata ho. do-while body pehle chalata hai, phir condition check karta hai.

modules.title: Pattern Programming
modules.goal: Nested loops se star, number, alphabet, pyramid, diamond aur hollow patterns banana.
modules.brief: Har pattern do sawaalon se banta hai: kitni rows? aur har row me kitne spaces + kitne characters?

modules.title: Functions
modules.goal: Functions declare, define aur call karna; parameters, return values, scope aur modular design samajhna.
modules.brief: Declaration (prototype) compiler ko signature batata hai; definition body deti hai; call function ko chalati hai. Prototype na ho to implicit declaration warning/error aata hai.

modules.title: Recursion
modules.goal: Recursion ka base case, call stack aur recursive vs iterative trade-off samajhna.
modules.brief: Base case ke bina recursion infinite chalti hai aur stack overflow deti hai.

modules.title: Arrays
modules.goal: 1D/2D arrays, initialization, traversal, search/sort aur memory layout samajhna.
modules.brief: Array ka naam pehle element ke address me decay hota hai; a[i] == *(a+i). Isliye bounds check C khud nahi karta — out-of-bounds read/write UB hai.

modules.title: Strings
modules.goal: Character arrays, null terminator aur string library ko safely use karna.
modules.brief: '\0' ke bina array sirf characters ka array hai, string nahi. strlen, printf %s sab null terminator par rukte hain — missing terminator out-of-bounds read karta hai.

modules.title: Pointers
modules.goal: Address, dereference, NULL, pointer arithmetic, const variants aur segfault ko memory maps ke saath samajhna.
modules.brief: & operator address deta hai, * operator us address par value (lvalue) deta hai. int *p = &x; *p = 5; se x badal jaata hai.

modules.title: Pointers, Arrays and Functions
modules.goal: Array decay, pointer parameters, double pointers, dynamic 2D arrays aur callbacks ko jodna.
modules.brief: void f(int a[], int n) aur void f(int *a, int n) same hain. sizeof a function ke andar pointer ka size deta hai.

modules.title: Structures, Unions and Enums
modules.goal: Struct, nested struct, array of structs, pointer/arrow, union, enum, typedef, padding aur self-referential struct.
modules.brief: struct Student { int roll; char name[32]; float marks; }; definition hai; struct Student s; object. Member access dot se, pointer se arrow (->).

modules.title: Dynamic Memory Allocation
modules.goal: Stack vs heap, malloc/calloc/realloc/free, leaks, dangling/double free aur ownership.
modules.brief: Stack automatic hai (scope se free), heap manual. malloc bytes leta hai aur uninitialized memory deta hai; calloc count*size leta hai aur zero karta hai; realloc resize karta hai (address badal sakta hai).

modules.title: File Handling
modules.goal: fopen modes, formatted aur binary I/O, seek aur error handling se persistent data likhna.
modules.brief: Modes: "r" read (must exist), "w" write (truncate/create), "a" append, "r+"/"w+"/"a+" read+write, "rb"/"wb" binary. Har successful fopen ka fclose zaroori hai.

modules.title: Preprocessor and Professional C
modules.goal: Macros, header guards, multi-file build, Makefile, argc/argv, GDB aur sanitizers.
modules.brief: #define PI 3.14159 object-like macro; #define SQ(x) ((x)*(x)) function-like macro — arguments ko brackets me rakho warna precedence bug. Macro me side effects (SQ(i++)) se bacho.

modules.title: Algorithms and Problem Solving
modules.goal: Complexity, linear/binary search, bubble/selection/insertion/merge/quick sort aur two-pointer patterns.
modules.brief: Big O worst-case growth batata hai: O(1) < O(log n) < O(n) < O(n log n) < O(n^2) < O(2^n). Constants ignore hote hain.

modules.title: Data Structures with C
modules.goal: Linked lists, stack, queue, BST, hash table aur BFS/DFS ko C me implement karna.
modules.brief: Singly linked list me node {data, next}; head se traverse; insert/delete me pointers update karo aur free karo. Doubly me prev pointer. Circular me tail next head ko.
